race.comment: CONFUCIOUS FLYER (3) led all the way to easily account for a maiden field of questionable quality last start over 1050m. Has only raced twice and the wraps are pretty big. Needs to step up today but should cope. BLANC VISAGE (9) impressed last time out, winding up powerfully to be beaten under a length over 1100m at Gawler. Should take a sit behind a strong tempo and will be tough to hold out again. SUPER WONDER (11) is a consistent three-year-old when went to Cranbourne last start and was swamped late in a 1000m BM70 against his own age. Taking on older sprinters now but can run a cheeky race. Recent Yarra Valley maiden winner REAL HEIR (10) takes on a deeper race today but has plenty of upside.
